relations.subject: Dilip Kumar Chakrabarti
relations.role: Professor Emeritus of South Asian Archaeology
relations.evidence: Dilip Kumar Chakrabarti (born 27 April 1941) is an Indian archaeologist, Professor Emeritus of South Asian Archaeology at Cambridge University

relations.subject: Dilip Kumar Chakrabarti
relations.object: McDonald Institute for Archaeological Research, Cambridge University
relations.evidence: and a Senior Fellow at the McDonald Institute for Archaeological Research, Cambridge University.

relations.subject: Dilip Kumar Chakrabarti
relations.evidence: He started his career as a lecturer of Archaeology at Calcutta University from 1965 to 1977.

relations.subject: Dilip Kumar Chakrabarti
relations.evidence: He was a reader of Archaeology at Delhi University from 1977 to 1990

relations.subject: Dilip Kumar Chakrabarti
relations.evidence: and also held a tenured appointment at Visva Bharati University from 1980 to 1981.

relations.subject: Dilip Kumar Chakrabarti
relations.evidence: He moved to a teaching post in South Asian archaeology at Cambridge University in 1990 and was promoted to professor prior to his retirement in 2008.

relations.subject: Dilip Kumar Chakrabarti
relations.evidence: He is presently Distinguished Fellow at the Delhi-based think tank, Vivekananda International Foundation
